course_name_original: Conception assistée par ordinateur / Conception-aided design

learning_outcomes.text: Develop an industry-oriented project using the CATIA software (group of 2 or 3 students).

syllabus_topics: A retractable vessel for sail boat (Cap Vert)
A study of the connexions of tramway carriage (Alstom)
A retractable landing gear on a glider
A compression machine for head gaskets for LET laboratory (industrial contract, mechatronics project)
A study of a fatigue machine for the LMPM laboratory
An opening system for A350 gear doors
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
